page.overview:
Who is Edamame Tsashimi?

Edamame Tsashimi is a Japanese sushi chef that appeared in Cars 2. He is an Alza Tutto Forklift that is painted white, with black lining around his doors and eyes, as well as a white and red headband. He is the brother of Daisu Tsashimi.
